headline.title: Take our I/O 2026 quiz, vibe coded in Google AI Studio.
headline.summary: Google AI Studio has been utilized to create a quiz centered around the key announcements from I/O 2026. The interactive quiz aims to engage users with the latest developments showcased at the event.

articles.title: 9 demos of Gemini Omni and Gemini 3.5 in action
articles.summary: The article showcases nine demonstrations of the Gemini Omni and Gemini 3.5 AI models, highlighting their capabilities and features. These demos illustrate the advancements in AI technology and the practical applications of the Gemini series.

articles.title: Botnet of more than 17 million devices dismantled
articles.summary: A botnet comprising over 17 million devices has been dismantled, with connections to a Russia-based residential proxy network. The operation highlights ongoing efforts to combat large-scale cyber threats and improve internet security.

articles.title: Coders are refusing to work without AI — and that could come back to bite them
articles.summary: Researchers caution that while AI tools are enabling coders to work more efficiently, they may not be enhancing the quality of the code produced. This reliance on AI could lead to potential issues in the future as the quality of software development may decline.

articles.title: After Nvidia’s $20B not-acqui-hire, AI chip startup Groq reportedly raising $650M
articles.summary: AI chip startup Groq is reportedly seeking to raise $650 million in funding as it shifts its focus from hardware to enhancing AI inference capabilities. This move follows Nvidia's recent $20 billion acquisition, which did not include Groq.

articles.title: Amazon Is Making an AI-Animated ‘Good Advice Cupcake’ TV Show. Its Original Creator Is Furious
articles.summary: Amazon is developing an AI-animated TV show based on "The Good Advice Cupcake," a character originally created by Loryn Brantz for BuzzFeed. Brantz has expressed anger over the licensing of her character for the series without her consent.

articles.title: Boston Children’s uses AI to unlock new diagnoses
articles.summary: Boston Children’s Hospital is leveraging OpenAI technology to enhance patient care and streamline operations, successfully diagnosing over 40 rare disease cases. The initiative aims to improve diagnostic accuracy and efficiency in pediatric healthcare.

articles.title: Check out real-life AI prototypes from the Futures Lab.
articles.summary: University of Waterloo students have created AI prototypes, including sign language tutors, aimed at transforming education and workplace interactions. These innovations were showcased at the Futures Lab, highlighting the potential applications of AI in real-world scenarios.

articles.title: Hands-On With Gemini Spark: I Gave It Access to My Life and It Friend-Zoned My Boyfriend
articles.summary: Google's AI agent, Gemini Spark, analyzed personal data such as emails and calendars to assist in planning a birthday party but failed to recognize the user's significant other as a key figure in their life. The experience highlights the limitations of AI in understanding personal relationships despite its capabilities in organizing tasks.

articles.title: So you’ve heard these AI terms and nodded along; let’s fix that
articles.summary: A new glossary has been released to help individuals understand the growing number of terms and slang associated with artificial intelligence. The resource aims to clarify key concepts and phrases that are becoming increasingly prevalent in discussions about AI.

articles.title: What happens when companies become too AI-pilled?
articles.summary: Box founder Aaron Levie warns that decision-makers advocating for AI to replace jobs often lack a true understanding of those roles, a phenomenon he describes as "AI psychosis." Recent layoffs, such as ClickUp's 22% workforce reduction due to AI agents, highlight the growing trend of tech companies downsizing amid increasing reliance on artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Today is the last day to apply to speak at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
articles.summary: Today is the final day to submit applications for speaking opportunities at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Interested individuals can propose session topics to contribute to discussions shaping the future of the tech industry.
